controls.title: Configure Data Access Control Lists
controls.intent: Ensure that access to data is restricted according to business need and least privilege by enforcing appropriate access control lists across enterprise systems.
security_goal: Restrict unauthorized access to sensitive data
controls.summary: Data should only be reachable by authorized systems and users according to defined access control policies. Unexpected network reachability to systems hosting sensitive data may indicate ineffective enforcement of access restrictions.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of whether network-level access restrictions protecting systems containing sensitive data are effectively enforced by validating observed communication against the intended segmentation policy.
expected_evidence: Unauthorized host reaches a protected system
Unexpected communication with systems containing sensitive data
Network reachability inconsistent with the intended access policy
assessment_notes: Unexpected communication with systems hosting sensitive data provides objective evidence that network-level access restrictions are not being enforced as intended.
NSSA evaluates network-level reachability rather than file system, database or application access permissions.
limitations: Cannot assess file system, database or application access control lists.
Cannot determine user identities, permissions or authorization decisions.
Only evaluates network-level access restrictions defined by the segmentation policy.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.intent: Ensure that data flows are documented and understood so that data movement can be appropriately secured and monitored.
controls.summary: Sensitive data should only traverse authorized communication paths. Unexpected network connectivity may indicate data flows that are inconsistent with the intended architecture or undocumented communication paths.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence that observed communication paths are consistent with the intended segmentation policy, helping identify unauthorized or unexpected network paths that may carry sensitive data.
expected_evidence: Observed connectivity inconsistent with the documented architecture
assessment_notes: Unexpected communication paths may indicate undocumented or unauthorized data flows requiring further investigation.
NSSA validates observable communication paths rather than documenting business-level data flows.
limitations: Cannot determine the type, sensitivity or contents of transmitted data.
Cannot automatically discover or document business data flows.
Only evaluates whether network communication paths conform to the intended segmentation policy.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
controls.intent: Ensure that network infrastructure is securely configured and maintained so that network communications are restricted according to the intended security architecture.
controls.summary: Network infrastructure should consistently enforce the intended communication policy. Unexpected network reachability may indicate that network device configurations are not producing the expected security behaviour.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of whether network infrastructure effectively enforces the intended segmentation policy by validating observed communication against expected network behaviour.
expected_evidence: Communication inconsistent with the intended segmentation policy
assessment_notes: Unexpected communication provides objective technical evidence that network infrastructure configurations are not enforcing the intended policy.
NSSA evaluates the observable behaviour of network infrastructure rather than configuration files or device settings.
limitations: Cannot inspect firewall, router or switch configurations.
Cannot determine which configuration caused the observed behaviour.
Does not assess configuration management processes or documentation.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.intent: Ensure that server-based firewalls restrict network communications to only those explicitly authorized.
controls.summary: Servers should only accept authorized network communications. Unexpected reachability may indicate that host-based firewall controls are not effectively enforcing the intended policy.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of whether server-hosted services are reachable only from authorized sources according to the intended segmentation policy.
expected_evidence: Unauthorized host reaches a protected server
assessment_notes: Observed communication with a server that should be protected provides objective evidence that network-level restrictions are not effectively enforced.
limitations: Cannot determine whether filtering is implemented by a host firewall, network firewall or another security control.
Cannot inspect firewall rules.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on End-User Devices
controls.intent: Ensure that end-user devices restrict network communications according to the intended security policy.
controls.summary: End-user devices should only permit authorized network communications. Unexpected reachability may indicate ineffective enforcement of host-level network restrictions.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of whether end-user devices are reachable according to the intended segmentation policy.
expected_evidence: Unexpected communication with an end-user device
assessment_notes: NSSA evaluates externally observable communication behaviour rather than firewall implementation.
limitations: Cannot determine whether host-based firewall software is installed or correctly configured.

controls.title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
controls.intent: Reduce the attack surface by ensuring that only required network services remain accessible.
controls.summary: Only services required for business operation should be reachable. Unexpected exposed services increase the attack surface and may indicate ineffective system hardening.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of unexpected network-accessible services by validating observed service reachability against the intended segmentation policy.
assessment_notes: NSSA evaluates externally observable service exposure rather than installed software or operating system configuration.
limitations: Cannot determine whether unnecessary services exist but are not network-accessible.
Cannot inspect operating system configuration.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.intent: Ensure that the network architecture enforces segmentation, least privilege and secure communication paths between enterprise systems.
controls.summary: Network architecture should ensure that communications occur only through authorized paths between authorized systems. Unexpected network reachability may indicate that the implemented architecture is not enforcing the intended security design.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence of whether the deployed network architecture enforces the intended segmentation policy by validating observed communication paths against the expected architecture.
assessment_notes: Unexpected communication provides objective technical evidence that the implemented network architecture is not enforcing the intended security boundaries.
NSSA evaluates the observable behaviour of the deployed architecture rather than architectural documentation or design decisions.
limitations: Cannot assess architectural documentation or design rationale.
Cannot determine how segmentation is implemented internally.
Only validates the effectiveness of the deployed architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.intent: Ensure that network infrastructure is managed in a manner that preserves the intended security posture and prevents unauthorized communications.
controls.summary: Network infrastructure should consistently enforce the intended communication policy. Unexpected connectivity may indicate ineffective management or configuration of network infrastructure.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence that network infrastructure is or is not enforcing the intended segmentation policy based on observed communication behaviour.
assessment_notes: Observed communication inconsistent with policy provides objective technical evidence that network infrastructure is not enforcing the intended restrictions.
limitations: Cannot determine whether secure management protocols or infrastructure-as-code are used.
Cannot inspect network device configurations.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.intent: Ensure that administrative access originates only from dedicated and appropriately isolated computing resources.
controls.summary: Administrative interfaces should only be reachable from dedicated and authorized systems. Unexpected administrative network access may indicate ineffective enforcement of privileged access restrictions.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA provides objective technical evidence that administrative services are only reachable from authorized systems by validating host-to-service communication against the intended segmentation policy.
expected_evidence: Unauthorized host reaches an administrative service
assessment_notes: Observed communication from unauthorized systems provides objective technical evidence that network restrictions protecting administrative resources are not being effectively enforced.
limitations: Cannot determine whether dedicated administrative workstations actually exist.
Cannot distinguish administrative users from standard users.
Only evaluates network-level communication restrictions.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.intent: Ensure that traffic between network segments is restricted to only authorized communications in accordance with the intended security policy.
controls.summary: Traffic between network segments should only be permitted where explicitly authorized. Unexpected network communication indicates that traffic filtering controls are not effectively enforcing the intended segmentation policy.
controls.nssa_relevance: NSSA directly validates whether traffic filtering between network segments is effectively enforced by comparing observed network reachability with the intended segmentation policy.
assessment_notes: Observed communication between network segments that should be isolated provides objective technical evidence that traffic filtering controls are not being effectively enforced.
NSSA evaluates the externally observable behaviour of traffic filtering rather than the underlying filtering technology.
limitations: Cannot determine whether filtering is implemented using firewalls, ACLs, routers or other security controls.
Cannot inspect filtering rules or device configurations.
